verdict.rationale: Fedora's first-party materials only hint at command-line tooling: packages, tools and runtimes are 'ready for use with just a single command', and the docs mention package management and container tooling. Nothing names or documents an official CLI, its scripting or automation behavior, or any fit for AI or agent workflows. Missing for 10: a named and documented official CLI, scriptable or machine-readable output suitable for agents, any AI-native or agent integration, and independent hands-on corroboration.
